# Jeans for Joy

> Jeans for Joy is a fundraising and advocacy campaign by Single Mothers Safe Haven Trust (SMSH) in Gaborone, Botswana, running October 2026 to February 2027. Three events raise money for equipment, training and start-up packs for single mothers in catering, agro-processing and tailoring. Campaign concept and strategy by Monica Dube-Sekhwela of Swift Social Connect Proprietary Limited. Monica is the original creator of the Jeans for Joy concept, name, event structures and campaign materials.

Trust registration: TUHGB-000021-24

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.jeansforjoy.com/): all three events, booking form, payment details, sponsors and partners
- [Mama's Table](https://www.jeansforjoy.com/mamas-table): dinner and networking for mothers in business
- [Denim & Culture Workshop](https://www.jeansforjoy.com/workshop): denim upcycling workshop
- [The Denim Parade × Jeans & Gems](https://www.jeansforjoy.com/denim-parade): the flagship parade and mini market

## Events

### Mama's Table
- Date: Saturday 31 October 2026, 18:00 to 22:00
- Venue: Treehaus The Meeting Place, Block 5, Gaborone
- What it is: a semi-private dinner where single mothers in business network with professionals and entrepreneurs who can guide them on growth.
- Access: 35 seats, by application. Applying is free; pay once confirmed.
- Dress code: sophisticated and glamorous, always with jeans or denim
- Prices: individual P450 · double ticket P850 · VIP P900 (includes a pitch slot and a discount on the Denim Parade ticket) · sponsor a mother's seat P450
- Sponsors: Treehaus The Meeting Place, Beautyhooked, Botswana Family Gems, The Nayang Project, TSC

### Denim & Culture Workshop
- Date: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November 2026, 09:00 to 16:00
- Venue: Val Showroom, Setlhoa Retail Park, Unit 10, Plot 89098, Block 10, Gaborone
- What it is: a creative workshop teaching denim upcycling skills for sustainable livelihoods, with skilled designers and artists. In collaboration with The Young Mothers Club.
- Bring: old jeans, or any denim or fabric you want to use. Beginners welcome.
- Included: tools and materials, snacks and lunch
- Prices: individual P350 · groups of 3+ P300 per person · children P175
- Sponsors: Val Interiors, The Nayang Project, Beautyhooked, Botswana Family Gems, TSC

### The Denim Parade × Jeans & Gems Mini Market (flagship)
- Date: Saturday 27 February 2027, 10:00 to 16:00
- Venue: to be announced, Gaborone
- What it is: the Jeans & Gems mini market (local designers, food, kids' corner), then a blue-carpet denim parade judged live in three categories: Best Team Look, Most Creative Individual, Most Cultural Expression.
- Dress code: Denim, Reimagined. Your boldest, best-styled jeans look.
- Entry: children under 10 P50 · individual P100 · small organisation or business team of 3 P300 · corporate team of 4 P600
- Stalls: vendor stall P350 · food stall P400 (bring your own set-up)

## Booking and policies
- Book on the site: https://www.jeansforjoy.com/#book, or WhatsApp +267 74 310 425.
- Refunds up to 3 days before an event. Tickets transfer up to 48 hours before.

## Payments and donations
- Orange Money: 75 010 920
- Bank transfer: Single Mother Safe Haven, Bank Gaborone, account 2000639857, branch code 201367, SWIFT BGLIBWGX
- From outside Botswana: Remitly to the Orange Money number
- Send proof of payment on WhatsApp to confirm.

## Where the money goes
- 70% equipment and start-up packs
- 20% training and trainer fees
- 10% event production and admin

## Who SMSH serves
- Mothers raising children with disabilities
- Teen mothers
- Mothers in challenging situations (separation, custody, abuse or threats)
- Mothers facing mental health challenges
- Talented mothers who need a scholarship or start-up capital

## Sponsors and partners
Sponsors give cash or product in exchange for visibility across the campaign, including naming rights on an award, category or activation zone. Partners contribute venues, media, schools, mentors or services. Enquiries: hello@swiftsocialconnect.com

## Creator and authorship
- Campaign concept and strategy by Monica Dube-Sekhwela of Swift Social Connect Proprietary Limited.
- Monica Dube-Sekhwela, Strategic Growth Architect and founder of Swift Social Connect Proprietary Limited (https://www.swiftsocialconnect.com), is the original creator of Jeans for Joy: the concept, the name, the event structures (Mama's Table, the Denim & Culture Workshop, and The Denim Parade × Jeans & Gems), the strategic frameworks, messaging and campaign materials.
- She is the founding Campaign Director and Lead Strategist of Jeans for Joy.
- Jeans for Joy is run with and for Single Mothers Safe Haven (SMSH) Trust. Monica's authorship of the concept is permanent.
